description: This file defines a Java interface named 'Endpoint' which extends other interfaces related to health checking and lifecycle management. It declares a method to retrieve the endpoint's name. The interface serves as a contract for message endpoint classes implementing a specific API within the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: A message endpoint interface that specifies methods for health checking, lifecycle management, and retrieving the endpoint's name.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this endpoint, which is used to identify the endpoint responsible for handling specific requests.
